target.statement: Runtime of SCCP (partial SVD) on the Newsgroups 3x5 matrix (2811x198) is 0.053 s, vs 0.13 s for full-SVD SCC
target.table_ref: Table II, row 'Newsgroups 3 x 5', column SCCP
target.dataset: 20 Newsgroups (TF-IDF word-document matrix, 2811x198, 3 doc clusters / 5 word clusters)

compute.basis: Paper code is MATLAB (needs reimplementation in Python), data is public 20 Newsgroups, matrices are tiny (2811x198) so runs take seconds; most time is downloading data, building TF-IDF matrices, and reimplementing the four methods plus 20-seed averaging.

blockers: Code is MATLAB, not runnable as-is on a typical laptop without MATLAB license; must be reimplemented
Word cluster labels are proxy labels from GloVe clustering, not provided; exact reproduction of CAcc/C-ARI needs the same proxy construction
Exact runtime numbers depend on MATLAB BLAS/LAPACK and hardware, so absolute seconds will not match
title: Randomized SVD Approximations for Spectral Co-Clustering of Word-Document Matrices
